ok can u make this text nicer pls. its to sam, he owes me two saturday shifts from september swaps and i want him to finally cover one

"hey sam! hope ur week is going ok. so if it's not too much, would u maybe be able to cover one of the saturdays u owe me? no worries at all if not!! i know its been a while.. i just closed tonight and work sat/sun mornings so a saturday off would be really nice 🙂 whenever works for u"

Happy to help! Your draft is warm, but the ask is a little buried. Here's a version that stays friendly while being clearer:

"Hey Sam! Hope your week's going well. Quick ask: could you cover one of the two Saturday shifts you owe me from the September swaps? I close tonight and work Sat/Sun mornings, so a Saturday off would really help. Could you let me know which Saturday works for you? Thanks so much! 🙂"

Want a softer or firmer version too?
hmm its a bit direct.. can u keep it nice not firm. like keep the 'if its not too much' part

Sure, here's a gentler version that still has a clear ask:

"Hey Sam! Hope your week's going okay 🙂 If it's not too much, would you be able to cover one of the Saturdays you owe me from the September swaps? I just closed tonight and I work Sat/Sun mornings, so a Saturday off would mean a lot. No pressure on timing, just let me know which one might work for you. Thank you!"

I kept the friendly tone and the "if it's not too much," and added "which one might work" so he has an easy way to reply with a date.
